Half right, and the load-bearing half is wrong. VERIFIED: NPCManager.as:1422 checkHitObject, :1429 'var distsq:int = dist * dist;', :1441 'enemydist = enemy.getMCS().x - thing.x;', :1444 'if(enemydist * enemydist < distsq && enemy.checkHitObject(thing,damage,checkByAttacker))'. So dist IS a horizontal half-width, not a radius -- that part survives, and the numbers reproduce (BigFireBreathProjectile.as:32 =600, BigWaveProjectile.as:34 =400, BigTornadoProjectile.as:33 =200, BigEarthquakeProjectile.as:68 =50). REFUTED ON: 'the hit test compares x-distance only' and 'a band +/-N px wide with unbounded y'. The very line the finding quotes ends with '&& enemy.checkHitObject(...)', and that function is NPC.as:323-341, which loops the MCS part list and requires 'mc.hitTestObject(thing)' -- a full 2D bounding-box overlap. The x-band is a broad-phase gate; the narrow phase is 2D. The lane_impact conclusion ('a circular-radius implementation would let an airborne or elevated target dodge an ultimate that in the original always connects') is therefore backwards: the original does NOT always connect vertically. The cite does not say what the claim says it says.

The cite resolves but does not say what the claim says it says, and the same file refutes it. Damage.as:50 is verbatim the eight-parameter constructor as quoted. Damage.as:18 'public static var STUN:int = 6;'. Decisive counter-example in the shipped data: FlashbangProjectile.as:26-27 'damageObj = new Damage(0,0,Damage.STUN); damageObj.setStunTime(24 * 2);' -- a status with a 48-frame duration riding the packet, for skill 1052 whose tooltip is 'Stuns and blinds nearby enemies.' What would survive is only the much weaker 'no ELEMENT-typed status field' -- which is not what was written.

new_findings.text: The WEB v0.717 twin of Obj_DragonDanceStatue is reference/decompiled/shs3_payload/scripts/§1t8703s0§.as, and it carries the SAME two sequence modes as android: props>=8 subtracts 8, clears earlierHeaven and picks one of five hard-coded orderings (1246/4216/1642/1426/6241) seeded on the current node with the node digit appended; otherwise the sequence is taken verbatim from the room prop. The Kanji-statue rule is therefore build-agnostic, not android-only.

Its three-regime generateSequence (3 / 5 / 6 clicks, seeded node*room+21) is present verbatim in the ANDROID build at Obj_DragonDancePath.as:150-224, so it is not a v0.717 change. getAPUse()->2 and abs(x - other.x) < 100 are shared by the whole Obj_ family and cannot identify a class.
new_findings.lane_impact: Cross-cutting method rule for this lane: an obfuscated web class must be pinned by a method NAME or a unique literal, never by a virtual override that every sibling shares. generateSequence survived obfuscation and pins §1t8702s0§ exactly. The unresolved '<20 / <60' gating value is also now named: NodeGenerator.getNodeLevel(currentNode), and the seed's second term is StageManager.getCurrentRoom().

new_findings.text: A status effect and its duration ARE carried on the Damage object. launchType (constructor parameter 3) is the status channel -- Damage.STUN = 6, with isStun()/isDeathTouch()/isKnockDown()/isFly() reading it -- and setStunTime(num, stunPosX) writes a frame duration onto the same object. Flashbang builds exactly that: new Damage(0,0,Damage.STUN) followed by setStunTime(24 * 2), i.e. a 48-frame stun with zero damage.
new_findings.lane_impact: rebirth-elements blocker 1 + combat-core: the status channel for the whole game is launchType + setStunTime, not the BUFF_* enum and not a bespoke per-projectile field. A rebuild should model status as a launchType tag on the damage packet with a frame duration. This is the artifact that refutes rebirth/status-not-on-damage-packet, and it also tells the lane exactly where to look for a per-element burn/slow: at each elemental projectile's 'new Damage(...)' call.

new_findings.text: The AoE dist parameter is a broad-phase HORIZONTAL gate only; the actual hit requires a 2D bounding-box overlap. NPCManager.checkHitObject filters on |dx| < dist and then calls NPC.checkHitObject, which walks the MCS part list and requires mc.hitTestObject(thing). So an elemental ultimate does NOT have unbounded vertical reach -- an airborne or elevated target whose parts do not overlap the projectile clip is missed.

NPC.as:326      var max:int = mcs.getPartListLength();
NPC.as:332      if(mc.hitTestObject(thing))
NPC.as:334         if(this.gotHit(mc,damage))
new_findings.lane_impact: combat-core + rebirth-elements: model the hit test as (horizontal broad-phase band of half-width dist) AND (per-part 2D overlap with the projectile clip). Implementing only the band makes every AoE hit airborne targets it should miss; implementing only a circle makes it miss grounded targets at range. The measured half-widths stand: Inferno 600 (BigFireBreathProjectile.as:32), Tsunami 400 (BigWaveProjectile.as:34), Tornado 200 (BigTornadoProjectile.as:33), Earthquake 50 (BigEarthquakeProjectile.as:68).

new_findings.text: The crit multiplier is a web-vs-android tuning split nobody in this packet claimed. Web v0.717 applies a single flat x1.3 plus the crit-damage stat regardless of stance; android v0.682 applies x1.5 in Light stance and x1.2 in every other stance. Both fire on the same deterministic trigger, reload == maxreload.
new_findings.lane_impact: combat-core + skills-meters: the ledger's 'crit 1.3x' is CONFIRMED for the web build and must be labelled web-specific -- a config seeded from the android decompile would ship a stance-dependent 1.2/1.5 crit instead. Combined with maxreload 192 vs 120 and the mastery 0-10 vs 0-100 scale, this is the fourth confirmed tuning split between the two builds in this packet.

new_findings.text: Both surviving SPD consumers in v0.717 are recovered in full. Skill-cooldown modifier: clamp SPD to 600, then return 1 - SPD/600*0.5 (so a floor of x0.5 at SPD>=600). Base slash length: int(120 + floor((90 + STAT_DAN*5) * SPD / (20 + SPD))) -- a Dan-scaled asymptote rising from 210 px at Dan 0 to 255 px at Dan 9 before the per-stance multiplier. Slash usage has its own floor of 48.
new_findings.lane_impact: L2/L5 blocker 4 (SPD->cooldown formula) is CLOSED with a web cite, and the reach base is closed with it. Note the shape: reach is asymptotic in SPD, so 294 px (Light, Dan 0) and 357 px (Light, Dan 9) are ceilings approached as SPD grows, not values at a particular SPD - any ledger row quoting them must say so. §1t9426s0§ is STAT_DAN (same const the rebirth routine tests at :2644).
